# --- RTP Operator / Command-Output Messages ---
# Strings emitted by operator-facing commands and menus: the scan command, the
# /rtp info diagnostics, and the generalized menu framework (front page, admin
# panel, config editor, maps, multi-config submenus).
#
# Formatting and shared [Pn] placeholders follow the same rules as player.yml.

# ###############################################################################
# Section 7: Scan Command
# ###############################################################################
# messages related to the scan command
# placeholder: [scan_regions] - list of regions
scanStart: "&a[P0] scan task started for regions: [scan_regions]"
scanReset: "&7[P0] scan queue reset for regions: [scan_regions]"
scanCancel: "&7[P0] scan task cancelled for regions: [scan_regions]"
scanPause: "#A020F0[P0] scan task paused for regions: [scan_regions]"
scanResume: "#10A5F5[P0] scan task resumed for regions: [scan_regions]"
scanRunning: "&c[P0] scan task already running for regions: [scan_regions]"
scanNotRunning: "&c[P0] scan task not running for regions: [scan_regions]"

# placeholder: [scan_chunks], [scan_totalChunks], [scan_cps], [scan_landPercentage], [scan_eta]
scanStatus: "[P0] &8» &7[scan_regions] &8| &7[scan_chunks]&8/&7[scan_totalChunks] &8| #7E9CC8[scan_cps]&7 cps &8| #7E9CC8[scan_landPercentage]%&7 land &8| &7ETA #7E9CC8[scan_eta]"

# Boss-bar title shown to players with rtp.scan permission while a world scan is running.
# Set to empty string to disable the boss-bar.
# The bar's color is taken from the first legacy color code in this value:
#   &c/&4 = red, &e/&6 = yellow, &a/&2 = green, &9/&1/&3/&b = blue,
#   &5 = purple, &d = pink, &f/&7/&8/&0 = white. Defaults to green if none.
# placeholder: [scan_regions], [scan_chunks], [scan_totalChunks], [scan_cps], [scan_landPercentage], [scan_progress], [scan_eta]
# [scan_landPercentage] = share of scanned locations that are valid land; [scan_progress] = percent of the scan completed.
scanBossBar: "&aScanning [scan_regions]: [scan_chunks]/[scan_totalChunks] ([scan_landPercentage]% land) ETA [scan_eta]"

# ###############################################################################
# Section 8: Info Command
# ###############################################################################
# messages related to the info command
infoTitle: "&2&l/rtp info"
infoTickets: "&7Global Active Chunk Tickets: #7E9CC8[tickets]"
infoTeleports: "&7Active Teleport State Machines: #7E9CC8[teleports]"
infoMSPT: "&7Current Plugin MSPT: #7E9CC8[mspt]"
infoTotalLoads: "&7Lifetime Chunks Loaded: #7E9CC8[loads]"
infoLoadsByOrigin: "&7Loads by Origin: #7E9CC8[loadsByOrigin]"
infoLeakRate: "&7Current Chunk Leak Rate: #7E9CC8[leakRate]"

# --- Health metrics block ---
infoQueueDepth: "&7Players Waiting In Region Queues: #7E9CC8[queueDepth]"
infoPendingTeleports: "&7Pending Teleport Pipelines: #7E9CC8[pendingTeleports]"
infoAvgPipelineMs: "&7Avg Pipeline Latency: #7E9CC8[avgPipelineMs] ms"

# Pipeline-latency percentiles. Placeholders: [pipelineMsP50] [pipelineMsP75]
# [pipelineMsP90] [pipelineMsP95] [pipelineMsP99] [pipelineSampleCount].
infoPipelinePercentiles: "&7Pipeline Latency (ms) P50/P75/P90/P95/P99: #7E9CC8[pipelineMsP50] / [pipelineMsP75] / [pipelineMsP90] / [pipelineMsP95] / [pipelineMsP99]&7 (n=[pipelineSampleCount])"

# Slow-teleport audit (immediate/unqueued teleports only). Placeholders:
# [slowPipelineCount] [slowPipelineThresholdMs].
infoSlowPipeline: "&7Slow Teleports (> #7E9CC8[slowPipelineThresholdMs]&7 ms): #7E9CC8[slowPipelineCount]"

# Queue-growth audit. Placeholders: [queueGrowthWarnCount] [queueGrowthWarnThreshold].
infoQueueGrowth: "&7Queue-Growth Warnings (>= #7E9CC8[queueGrowthWarnThreshold]&7): #7E9CC8[queueGrowthWarnCount]"
infoHeap: "&7JVM Heap: #7E9CC8[heapUsedMb] / [heapMaxMb] MiB"

# Header line for the Health pipeline labelled block in /rtp info.
infoHealthPipelineHeader: "&7--- Health: pipeline ---"

# TPS readout for the 1m / 5m / 15m windows. Placeholders: [tps1m] [tps5m] [tps15m].
infoTps: "&7TPS (1m/5m/15m): #7E9CC8[tps1m] / [tps5m] / [tps15m]"

# Live server MSPT and tick-budget utilisation. Placeholders: [mspt] [tickBudgetUtilisation].

# Configured player soft-cap vs current online count. Placeholders: [softCap] [playerCount].

# Most recent database round-trip latency in ms. Placeholder: [databaseLatencyMs].

# sub-info listings
# placeholders: [world], [region], [requirePermission], [override], [shape], [worldBorderOverride], [cacheCap], [cached], [keptCache], [unkeptCache], [backlogCache], [backlogCacheCap]
# learned-state placeholders (resolve to N/A when the region has no memory shape or has not been scanned): [memCoveragePct], [memBadPct], [memBadCount], [memTopCause], [memTopCausePct]

# --- RTP Region Configuration ---
# Documentation: plugins/RTP/docs/admin/configuration/REGIONS.md

# "[0]" = main world, "[1]" = 2nd loaded world, etc.
# @type: enum
# @source: world

#

# radius is the outer edge (nobody lands past it), centerRadius is the inner edge / donut hole
# (nobody lands inside it), and centerRadius must stay below radius or there is no land left to pick from.
#
# The teleport radius can be set in two places; pick ONE:
#   1. Shared default (most servers): edit `defaults.shape.radius` in config.yml.
#      Leaving the value below as "@config" inherits that whole `defaults.shape`
#      block, so a single-world server sets radius/centerRadius once, there.
#   2. Per-region override (this region only): replace "@config" with an inline

#     mode: "ACCUMULATE"
#     radius: 256

#     minY: 32

backlogcachecap.title: backlogCacheCap
backlogcachecap.desc:
Capacity of the **L3 Backlog Cache** unverified staging buffer (ADR-028).

### How It Works
- Pre-picks candidate coordinates along the spiral without performing any chunk loads or database writes.
- Each region pulse picks the oldest candidate, determines its 32x32 Anvil/Linear region file bin, and classifies all candidates in that bin off-tick in one amortized pass.
- Keeps the verified `cacheCap` constantly replenished so `/rtp` teleports are instantaneous.
- On `rtp-lite`, defaults to `0` (disabled) to conserve RAM.

activechunkcap.title: activeChunkCap
activechunkcap.desc:
Maximum number of chunks held in the **L1 Hot Queue** with loaded chunk tickets (`keep(true)`) for zero-latency instant teleports.

- When a location is verified, its chunk is kept loaded in L1.
- If L1 reaches `activeChunkCap`, additional verified locations are demoted to the L2 Cold Queue (chunks released from memory, reloaded asynchronously on demand).
- Prevents server RAM exhaustion and force-loading leaks (S-002).

Ordered boundary coordinate pairs defining an arbitrary closed polygon (when `shape: POLYGON`).

Uses identical syntax to Chunky `/chunky shape polygon`:
```yaml
vertices:
  - [-2000, 3000]

  - [2000, -3000]
```

- Requires at least 3 vertices.
- Vertices must not be all collinear.
- Boundary edges must not self-intersect.
- `expand` is not supported on polygons (authoring your own boundary locks the perimeter).

shape.title: shape
shape.desc:
The **`shape`** block defines the horizontal area where players can land and selects candidate coordinates.

### Selection Modes (`mode:`)
- **`ACCUMULATE`**: *(Recommended)* Even distribution, pre-calculated sectors, 1D Archimedean spiral mapping (ADR-001) or continuous Hilbert key space (ADR-085). Best for general server play.
- **`NEAREST`**: Finds the closest non-blocked candidate location. Fast, but may cause player clustering.
- **`REROLL`**: Simple random selection with retries. Even probability but unbounded retry steps.
- **`NONE`**: Pure candidate walk with zero pre-computation. Ideal for massive radii (> 50,000 blocks).

### Supported Shape Engines
- **`CIRCLE`**: Uniform radial disk bounded by `radius` with inner donut deadzone `centerRadius`.
- **`SQUARE`**: Square bounding frame extending `radius` chunks per side.
- **`POLYGON`**: Arbitrary closed polygon boundary defined by `vertices: [[x1, z1], ...]`.
- **`ELLIPSE`**: Circle with independent X and Z semi-axes (`radius`, `radius2`) to match rectangular world borders.
- **`RECTANGLE`**: Explicit side lengths (`width`, `height`) centered on `centerX`/`centerZ`.
- **`CIRCLE_NORMAL` / `SQUARE_NORMAL`**: Gaussian normal distribution clustering around `mean` with spread `deviation`.

### Distance Units
All distances support spatial unit suffixes:
`256c` (chunks), `4096b` (blocks), `4r` (regions), `5km` (kilometers), or `500nb` (Nether blocks).

> 💡 **Operator Gotcha:** `centerRadius` must be strictly smaller than `radius`. If `centerRadius >= radius`, no pickable band remains!

vert.title: vert
vert.desc:
The **`vert`** block controls how the Y coordinate (height / elevation) is chosen once a horizontal position is selected.

### Vertical Adjustor Engines
- **`JUMP`**: Scans vertically using fixed `step` block intervals (default: `16`). Fast for finding open surface terrain.
  - *Nether Caveat:* Because `step` skips in 16-block intervals, it can skip thin 1-2 block ledges. In the Nether, prefer `LINEAR` bottom-up.
- **`LINEAR`**: Thorough scan of every Y level between `minY` and `maxY`.
  - `direction: 0`: **Bottom-up** (scans `minY` to `maxY`). Recommended for Nether floor and cave teleports.
  - `direction: 1`: **Top-down** (scans `maxY` to `minY`). Ideal for surface landings.
  - `direction: 2`: **Middle-out** (starts in middle and scans outward).
  - `direction: 3`: **Edges-in**.
- **`FIXED`**: Places player at an exact mid-air Y level (`y: 64`) with no terrain scan. Designed for skyblock worlds; pair with a platform builder!

### Common Settings
- `minY` / `maxY`: Safe elevation bounds (e.g. `32` to `255`, or `32` to `120` in the Nether).
- `requireSkyLight`: When `true`, accepts only locations with direct sky access (above ground only).
